text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The final showdown with the "Golden 
Generation"—the Arima Kinen. Clad in royal 
dignity, I step onto that stage.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Shaken to the core by that majestic aura, 
everyone murmured... "She is truly the 
great sovereign—"

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Today would surely become the day of 
coronation for the "End of the Century 
Overlord"... so it was believed.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
—Now, everyone! Behold the finale to the 
'Rise of the End-of-Century Overlord'!
